Museums or cultural-event organisers could hypothetically sponsor discovery content. The local receipts signal activities to publicise, not sponsorship budgets, purchasing authority or interest in this channel. A later human-run payer interview should investigate those gaps without promising reach.
No customer contact, recruitment, listening tests, payment, deployment or implementation has occurred.
Whether this audience currently struggles with discovery, how often, and whether existing listings already solve it.
dissent: The receipts may support occasional event discovery better than a daily storytelling habit; a weekly format could be a better hypothesis.
EU tourism volume should not be used to enlarge the commuter market estimate or imply Riga customer demand.
Sponsorship could introduce promotional pressure before independent editorial value is demonstrated.
